tickets.title: Coordinate Divorce Planning Documents
tickets.text: Use this workflow to request, organize, and route divorce‑related planning documents for analysis. Keep communications neutral and factual, confirm authorization before sharing information with outside professionals, and separate advisory planning needs from legal advice. Coordinate with attorney Corin Nettlewhisk and CPA Jules Thimblefern to prepare a planning packet that includes draft settlement terms, asset schedules, support estimates, retirement‑account order questions, and current statements for Nadia Pebblefizz.

subTasks.title: Confirm document scope and permissions
subTasks.text: Identify which documents are needed, such as draft or final settlement terms, asset schedules, support obligations, retirement account orders, tax returns, and current statements. Confirm Nadia Pebblefizz's written permission before coordinating with an attorney, CPA, or mediator.

subTasks.title: Create secure collection folder
subTasks.text: Set up a secure upload location, list missing items, and label received documents by category. Do not request or store unnecessary sensitive documents beyond the planning scope.

subTasks.title: Prepare planning summary for advisor review
subTasks.text: Summarize available assets, liabilities, income obligations, beneficiary concerns, account titling issues, and open questions for the advisor. Flag any urgent implementation constraints without providing legal conclusions.

tickets.evidence: They agreed by 2026-07-17 to coordinate with attorney Corin Nettlewhisk and CPA Jules Thimblefern after written authorization, with a planning packet covering draft settlement terms, asset schedules, support estimates, retirement-account order questions, and current statements.

tickets.title: Collect Client Tax Documents
tickets.text: Request and organize current tax documents for planning review, including prior-year federal and state returns, W-2s, 1099s, K-1s, estimated tax payment records, charitable giving summaries, and any tax notices. Track missing items and route complete packet to the planning team. Collect the most recent joint tax return, the latest property tax bill, and the current Teacup Comet Bank mortgage payoff statement for Nadia Pebblefizz.
tickets.evidence: the most recent joint return, latest property tax bill, and current Teacup Comet Bank mortgage payoff are still needed by 2026-07-15

tickets.title: Check Beneficiary Change Forms Against Restrictions
tickets.text: Check the beneficiary‑change forms for Nadia Pebblefizz against attorney Corin Nettlewhisk’s temporary restrictions before submitting any changes.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up by 2026-07-24 is to check forms against Corin’s temporary restrictions before any beneficiary change is submitted.
